description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Garrison Cat, adding {C}{C}.
When Garrison Cat dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Garrison Cat trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Garrison Cat from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
